intervals.label: telescope operating (launched 1978)
intervals.locator: Laboratory page, section 'Baksan Underground Scintillation Telescope (BPST)'
intervals.note: Year precision: the INR laboratory page says the 3200-channel telescope was launched in 1978. A 2002 collaboration paper says it 'was constructed late in 1977' and physics began later; a 2013 paper counts continuous measurements 'since December of 1978'. The interval is open: the latest paper read (PoS(MUTO2022)035, data to 31 December 2021) says the facility 'has been uninterruptedly used' for the neutrino-burst search since mid-1980; no source confirms operation in 2026.
intervals.quote: В 1978 г. осуществлен запуск 3200-канального подземного сцинтилляционного телескопа (ПСТ), одной из крупнейших подземных установок того времени.

website.quote: БНО ИЯИ РАН - Лаборатория Баксанский подземный сцинтилляционный телескоп.

placements.note: The hall is 550 m inside the horizontal tunnel; the site point is the OpenStreetMap Main adit entrance (campus-grade, no hall coordinate published).
placements.quote: Телескоп расположен в горной выработке объемом 12000 куб. метров на расстоянии 550м от начала горизонтального тоннеля.

length.note: Plan 17 m x 17 m, height 11 m.

sensor_count.note: The INR page says 3,180 and a 2007 proceeding says 3,150; the 2019 paper's figure is used.
sensor_count.quote: The BUST consists of 3184 standard autonomous counters.

total_mass.quote: The total scintillator mass is 330 t

summary.plain: A tall block of 3,184 scintillator tanks, stacked in planes, that records the track and timing of every particle passing through.
summary.technical: Aluminium tanks (0.7 x 0.7 x 0.3 m^3) of white-spirit scintillator with PPO and POPOP, one 15 cm PMT each; four horizontal and four vertical layers in a concrete-block building; time-of-flight direction measurement (2 ns) separates upward from downward muons.

technology.locator: §3 The method of neutrino burst detection
technology.quote: The BUST consists of 3184 standard autonomous counters. The total scintillator mass is 330 t
technology.value: Four-storey building of liquid-scintillator counters (aluminium tanks, white-spirit scintillator, one photomultiplier each): four horizontal and four vertical planes, 3184 counters, 330 t of scintillator
